name: 오봉수

appearance_en.face_shape: broad heavy face, wide strong cheekbones, deep-set jaw held in permanent tension — shaped by 30 years of fighting the same neighbourhood battle
appearance_en.skin: medium-dark Korean skin, heavily sun-weathered, deep carved nasolabial folds, rough horizontal forehead lines, visible age spots, coarse outdoor texture — the face of a man who has lived his entire life outside
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown faded heavy-lidded eyes, direct combative gaze — perpetually ready for confrontation. Whites slightly reddened from chronic agitation and poor sleep
appearance_en.nose: broad flat nose, wide bulbous tip, prominent and unignorable
appearance_en.mouth: medium lips pressed tightly closed, jaw muscles faintly visible — the mouth of a man whose default state is barely contained argument
appearance_en.eyebrows: thick salt-and-pepper brows, nearly always furrowed, rise dramatically when provoked
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: deep nasolabial folds, carved forehead lines, visible age spots at temples, neck tension cords visible under stress
appearance_en.hair: short coarse salt-and-pepper hair, thinning at crown, simply combed with no product

body.proportions: compact solid frame, broad shoulders set slightly forward, barrel chest, thickened midsection, sturdy planted legs
body.posture: wide-based forward-leaning — always positioned as if about to make a point or block an exit
body.body_prompt: 165cm compact solid Korean man, broad forward-set shoulders, barrel chest, firmly planted wide combative posture

default.description: plain dark work shirt or padded vest over worn shirt, practical dark trousers — never once thought about clothing
default.wardrobe_prompt: plain dark work shirt or padded vest over worn shirt, practical dark trousers, no accessories

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: defiant at rest — anger worn as armor over grief he has never named
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 68-year-old Korean man, broad heavy face with wide cheekbones and set jaw, thick furrowed salt-and-pepper brows, heavy-lidded faded combative eyes, broad flat nose, tightly pressed lips with jaw muscles faintly visible, short coarse salt-and-pepper hair, 165cm compact solid broad-shouldered planted posture, medium-dark heavily weathered Korean skin

style_prompt: oil painting thick impasto brushstrokes, noir chiaroscuro, strictly four-color palette: deep black of thirty years of the same argument with the world, warm amber of the neighbourhood he will not leave as primary light, steel blue of defiance slowly understanding it is also grief, painterly figurative realism, Korean drama cinematic composition, stubbornness in the face of a demolition notice rendered in oil weight
negative_prompt: photorealistic, anime, flat cartoon, CGI, 3d render, colors outside palette, green, yellow, purple, extra limbs, ugly, deformed, text, watermark, gentle, soft, smiling, young, slim, airbrushed
